zh.title: 阿聯酋航空開航赫爾辛基　以A350-900執飛第四個北歐航點
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空自10月1日起，以A350-900每日執飛杜拜至赫爾辛基航線，提供全年直飛服務，赫爾辛基成為其第四個北歐航點。
body: 阿聯酋航空於2026年10月1日開航杜拜國際機場（DXB）至芬蘭赫爾辛基機場（HEL）的每日直飛航線，由空中巴士A350-900客機執飛。赫爾辛基成為該公司繼哥本哈根、奧斯陸及斯德哥爾摩之後的第四個北歐航點，進一步擴大其在北歐市場的布局。
根據阿聯酋航空公布的班表，去程EK167於上午8點15分自杜拜起飛，下午2點30分抵達赫爾辛基；回程EK168於下午4點20分自赫爾辛基起飛，翌日凌晨0點20分抵達杜拜，以上均為當地時間。航線採全年營運，提供芬蘭與阿拉伯聯合大公國之間的定期直飛服務。
執飛客機配置298席，設有商務艙、豪華經濟艙及經濟艙。旅客可經杜拜轉接阿聯酋航空在亞洲、非洲、中東及澳洲等地的航班；首航亦搭載來自臺北、孟買、胡志明市及雪梨等逾20座城市的轉機旅客。
赫爾辛基機場營運商Finavia於10月2日發布的首航報導，明確指出首班航機已於10月1日抵達，因此開航日期為10月1日，10月2日則是首航消息的發布日期。

en.title: Emirates Launches Helsinki Service With A350-900 on Its Fourth Nordic Route
en.summary: Emirates began daily, year-round flights between Dubai and Helsinki on October 1, using the Airbus A350-900 for its fourth Nordic destination.
body: Emirates launched daily nonstop flights between Dubai International Airport (DXB) and Helsinki Airport (HEL) in Finland on October 1, 2026, using Airbus A350-900 aircraft. Helsinki becomes the airline's fourth Nordic destination after Copenhagen, Oslo and Stockholm, expanding its presence in the region.

According to the schedule published by Emirates, outbound flight EK167 departs Dubai at 08:15 and arrives in Helsinki at 14:30. Return flight EK168 leaves Helsinki at 16:20 and reaches Dubai at 00:20 the following day. All times are local. The route operates year-round, providing scheduled nonstop service between Finland and the United Arab Emirates.

The aircraft has 298 seats across Business, Premium Economy and Economy. Passengers can connect through Dubai to Emirates services across Asia, Africa, the Middle East and Australia. The inaugural flight also carried connecting passengers from more than 20 cities, including Taipei, Mumbai, Ho Chi Minh City and Sydney.

In its inaugural-flight report published on October 2, Helsinki Airport operator Finavia explicitly stated that the first flight arrived on October 1. The route therefore launched on October 1, while October 2 was the publication date of the report.
